claims.text: This reflects the significant contribution of the lighter, bulkier alcohol molecules to the mixture volume.

claims.text: - The propan-2-ol + water system is well known for exhibiting **negative excess volumes** (volume contraction on mixing), particularly in the water-rich region, due to strong hydrogen-bonding interactions between propan-2-ol and water molecules.
claims.reason: Negative excess volume and hydrogen-bond/packing effects in aqueous alcohol mixtures are accepted qualitative chemistry.
